title: Power Rankings: Spurs hold on to No. 1 spot
heading: 2010-11 Power Rankings: Week 13
author: Marc Stein

rankings.summaryHtml: Without a 20-point scorer, San Antonio has 17 straight home wins and a 5 1/2-game lead on the rest of the West. That's the good news. The bad news? The Spurs finally have an injury worry: George Hill's right thumb.
